_rules.doc: 0.3.9 a tile is overlaid by up to 2 higher-priority neighbouring floors; frame = edges(N1 E2 S4 W8) | corners(NW1 NE2 SE4 SW8)<<4 (corners only where both sides are not that floor). Water, walls and the moat never blend. 0.3.10 priorities x10 so the region grasses (21-23) and rocky ground (35) blend softly into each other.
